description: Atlas — a general-purpose everyday agent. Dark-first mission console: near-black ink-blue canvas, one amber accent, top bar with breadcrumb and search, sectioned sidebar (Home, missions, plans, reminders, notes, chats), one wide centred chat column. Home overview is the default view. The tool trace is an inline timeline under each answer plus an overlay drawer. Runs on the user’s own free Gemini API key; nothing is faked.

design.references: Linear (home/overview with ruled stat row, hairline rules, restrained motion, calm sidebar), Raycast (command palette, keyboard-first, fuzzy search with grouped results), Attio (record lists with progress and counts), Vercel dashboard (tabular numerals, dense but calm)
design.signature: the desk — near-black ink-blue canvas, hairline 1px rules, one amber accent used sparingly, top bar with breadcrumb and search, sectioned sidebar, Home overview as the default view, one wide centred chat column, tool trace as an inline timeline under each answer plus an overlay drawer on demand.

name: atlas-agent
